answer: Reputation Prism Split. Each identity’s actions are projected through a prism into separate task-domain profiles; an orchard of domain scores must stay correlated across epochs. Enforcement: if an identity’s domain profiles diverge beyond a fixed angle while its volume rises, the atlas of cross-epoch history is reweighted and flagged. Attacker cost: sustaining plausible correlation across every domain for many epochs, which multiplies per-clone labor and history-keeping.
